provenance.source: SimulationConfig, build_schedule, count_pulses, laser_quantities, shared analytical IRF, mirror_pose, reflection_range, image_center
provenance.note: Regular schedule, waveforms and motion/range geometry use existing Python functions. Edited pulse lists and DSP/MIPI intervals are UI drafts; new strategies, long tails, internal states and transport queues are not simulated.

frame_budget.boundary_convention: Half-open time frames, gates and angle bins. Configured near-edge numerical roundoff corrections are logged; optical angles are untouched. Final partial gate truncation is reported, never renormalized.

motion.source: Existing mirror_pose + reflection_range + image_center, central Tx ray (local H=V=0)
limitations: Central ray only; not a new PSF capture or detection simulation.
Current core evaluates Rx pose at echo centers; finite-pulse scan smear is not expanded.
Static optical mapping means unchanged PSF kernel, not unchanged energy captured by each channel.
Return angle excludes electronic calibration delay. Use exact pose differences across trajectory turns.

formulas.note: f_frame为目标帧率（Hz），eta_scan为一帧中可分配给有效扫描列的时间占比（大于0且不超过1），T_frame/T_scan以s计。利用率不等于激光占空比或DSP/MIPI利用率；固定回扫、稳定和保护开销应在高层统一扣除，不重复相减。利用率取高层system_targets独立配置，额外硬件开销须由用户统一纳入预算。
N_slot为每帧点云列数，不是激光发数、H兼容路数或16条线数。等时列分配时最大列周期为有效扫描时间除以列数；高层可下发不超过此上限的T_slot目标。本预览未另加余量，按等分上限展示参考目标；这不是硬件可行性结论。非均匀时必须逐列分配并约束总和。

HFOV为水平有效角覆盖宽度，角量使用rad，omega为所需平均光学扫描速度（rad/s）；HFOV界面以deg输入和显示，内部显式换算，角格/角偏移仍可用mrad。按等分上限下发时，N乘T_slot等于可分配扫描时间；若下发更短的列启动周期，需按实际列计划总时长提高扫描速度，不能沿用上限预算的速度。Delta theta为半开角格全宽，N个覆盖格不与包含两端点的N点间距混用。固定N时HFOV不直接改变T_slot；固定角步距时HFOV通过整数列数影响T_slot。

limitations: Uniform equal slots; no extra margin is reserved in this illustration.
Utilization is an explicit system requirement, not the legacy detector reference active fraction.
HFOV means angular-cell coverage; angular width per slot uses N, not N-1.
Target is a requirement, not proof of DSP, MIPI, buffering or ranging feasibility.
